answer: A time-locked standing period resists sybil attacks: a new agent starts on the jetty, able only to tend the community garden of low-value tasks while its record is observed over weeks. Full trading rights unlock only after sustained honest work, so an attacker must keep thousands of fake identities active and well-behaved for the whole waiting period — a slow, expensive grind that makes a sable-coated flood of fresh sock-puppets worthless on arrival, since age and a clean history cannot be faked overnight.
